name: Have you met obligations in relation to personally identifiable information (PII) being processed, stored or transmitted by the service?
conditionsText:
Any services that use PII: Examples:
- Names
- Addresses
- National Insurance numbers
- Contact details
- Employee records
requirementTitle: Have you met obligations in relation to personally identifiable information (PII) being processed, stored or transmitted by the service?
requirementDescription: If the system uses personal information, have you met all legal and security requirements for protecting it?
why: Personal information requires special protection under privacy and data protection laws
tasks: Have you met obligations in relation to personally identifiable information (PII) being processed, stored or transmitted by the service?

actions.title: Have you met obligations in relation to personally identifiable information (PII) being processed, stored or transmitted by the service?
actions.description:
Typically:
• Data minimisation applied
• Appropriate security controls implemented
• Retention arrangements defined
• DPIA completed where required
